GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 3 Wide 6 lengths. moved up Wide turn 3 lengths. weakened # 3 Wide trip
Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground with the winner in Straight moving through equal 7th to 4th place # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was inclined to lay in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Hampered @ start. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & Two Wide @ 650m. Pushed out Four Wide @ 500m & pushed to quicken Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & outsprinted Seven Wide in straight. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was hampered by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. moved up 3rd turn under pressure. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Pulled hard in the middle stages. Passing the 800m was inconvenienced by rnr which when racing keenly had to be restrained from the heels of other rnr and was shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. back to 3rd 1000 metres. moved up 3 Wide turn joining leaders. ran about in Straight . battled on well # had excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung in during the straight and near the 300m shifted in and made contact with another runner. Passing the 200m shifted in again when hanging and had to be corrected by its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down last 6 lengths. moved up Wide turn 3 lengths. ran on strongly with winner # just missed
Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 lengths. hard ridden turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Restrained from Wide barrier 1200 Eased keen early & middle stages rear 8l 1 off home turn 5l 3 Wide very Wide Straightening Up One paced run home # too keen/ fair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Approaching the 1200m was eased when awkwardly placed on heels. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 5l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 4l off, worked home well making steady ground # back/ran on well

Began OK. Worked fwd Four Wide until raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) @ 1100m. Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & back 2 Lengths @ 700m. Pushed along Two Wide @ 550m & chasing Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 300m & weakened in last 200m. # Worked & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced wide without cover in the early stages & was allowed to stride forward to obtain a position outside the leader near the 1200m. Laid out near the 100m & was bumped on the hindquarter. Rdr stated near the 200m, after his mnt weakened significantly & he had concerns for its action, he eased out of the event. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Co-tnr reported the gelding would now be spelled. Notwithstanding this advice & considering comments from rdr, co-tnr was told a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial. V/C received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in straight. (Winkers FIRST TIME) # ran on fairly
